protocol.title: Measuring Droplet Volume in Home-Made Microfluidic Devices
protocol.objective: Determine droplet volume in a home-made microfluidic device using monodisperse polystyrene beads as a volumetric calibration standard via Poisson-statistics-based droplet occupancy measurement

beads.notes: Fluorescent beads recommended for easier identification in droplets under microscopy

pbs.role: Cell-channel syringe fluid (co-flow with bead syringe)
pbs.notes: Loaded into the syringe intended for cells; no cells present in this calibration run

bead_concentration_in_droplet.explanation: Co-flowing beads with PBS at equal volume ratio halves the bead concentration from 1000 to 500 beads/uL in the combined aqueous droplet fluid

volume_calculation.droplet_occupancy_definition: Total beads counted inside droplets / number of droplets counted
volume_calculation.notes: Count beads inside several hundred droplets to ensure a statistically sound occupancy estimate

steps.name: Prepare bead suspension
steps.details: Purchase durable monodisperse 10 um carboxylated polystyrene beads (Bangs Labs PC06N-11355 or fluorescent FC06F-10163). Wash and resuspend in Drop-seq lysis buffer at 1000 beads/uL. Draw into a syringe equipped with a magnetic mixer as per standard barcoded-bead protocol.

steps.name: Load PBS into cell-channel syringe
steps.details: Load the syringe intended for cells with regular PBS. When co-flowed with the bead syringe, the bead concentration in the combined droplet fluid is estimated at 500 beads/uL.

steps.name: Co-flow and droplet generation
steps.details: Connect all tubing to the appropriate channels in the microfluidic device. Start both syringe pumps; bead suspension and PBS co-flow into the aqueous inlet. The carrier oil generates droplets at the T-junction or flow-focus nozzle. Duration models the stabilisation period before droplet collection begins.
steps.abstraction_note: mix abstracts the co-flow merging of two aqueous streams at the chip inlet junction; not a DMF electrode-merging event. Effective bead concentration in resulting droplets: 500 beads/uL.

steps.name: Bead counting and occupancy detection
steps.details: Image several hundred droplets under microscopy (fluorescence if fluorescent beads; brightfield otherwise). Count total beads inside all imaged droplets. Compute occupancy = total_beads / total_droplets. Compute volume = occupancy / 500 beads/uL.

pass.meaning: Beads detected in droplets; valid droplet population; volume estimate obtained

fail.meaning: No bead signal; device failure (check tubing, nozzle, oil flow rate, bead resuspension)

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 4 basic blocks (BB1-BB4), 1 if/else gate, 4 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in seconds (s); no conversion needed (no h tokens used)

known_compiler_behaviors.drain_to_dispose_lowering: drain in .bs source correctly lowered to dispose in IR (bsbbif_3_f); expected compiler behavior
known_compiler_behaviors.missing_true_branch_jump: bsbbif_2_t lacks unconditional jump to bsbbif_4_j in IR; known compiler-side emission limitation; DOT edge BB2->BB4 is correct

bioscript_compiler_notes.ownership_audit: beadSuspension and pbsFlow each consumed once by mix; combinedFluid consumed once by detect; no fluid variable reused after consumption; no ownership violations
